node_types.definition: A single assertion drawn from a published work, directly attributable to Wulf A. Kaal, carrying its canonical URL, scope conditions and verification status.
The verbatim passage from the source document that a Claim rests on, carrying passage_sha256 and source_sha256.
A published work in the corpus that one or more Claims are drawn from.
An agent-facing capability class that Claims are projected onto.
The author of the claims. Identified by ORCID.

edge_types.definition: Claim to AgentCapability. The claim bears on the named capability class.
Claim to ScholarlyArticle. The work the claim was argued in.
Claim to SourcePassage. The exact passage the claim rests on.
Claim to Person. Authorship of the claim.

note: graph.jsonld sets @vocab to https://wulfkaal.github.io/agentic-claim-graph/v1#. Node and edge type terms resolve against this document. The capability terms below classify claims; they are not marketing categories.
